notes: Code-verified against routes/Agents.svelte, components/agents/AgentsOverview.svelte, AgentExamples.svelte, agentExamples.ts and components/packages/PackagePreviewDialog.svelte.

The binary proposes no example of its own yet, so the three example commands are stubbed: list_example_packages, preview_example_package and install_example_package. The stubbed values imitate ExamplePackage of crates/apollia-runtime/src/packages/examples.rs and PackagePreview of crates/apollia-runtime/src/packages/preview.rs: a field renamed there drifts here silently. The real list, preview and installation are held by the runtime tests of the example routes.

The seed installs agents, so the section opens as a band and agents-examples-show opens the cards; the section open from the start, on a screen with nothing else, is held by the Playwright spec tests/agents/examples.spec.ts.

A stub is static: the list answers one example proposed and one installed from the start, so the card of the installed one (agents-example-installed, agents-example-open-sheet) is read without an installation, and the card of the accepted one still reads proposed afterwards. agents-example-open-sheet is read and not clicked: the stubbed agent is not installed, and its sheet would wait for it.

Not folded into master-det: this book has not been through a runtime round yet. Add it to ORDER in tools/regen_master.py after its first green solo run: just automation-seeded scripts/automation/agent-examples-det.json
